page_title: STR 5-0 ANG | Strasbourg v Angers 05/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.

90+5' Julio Enciso (Strasbourg) controls a neat pass and has options, but decides to shoot from distance. The ball flies low towards the middle of the net, but Herve Koffi is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
90+4' Strasbourg players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
88' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Strasbourg was in an offside position.
85' Kendry Paez (Strasbourg) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
84' Liam Rosenior prepares a substitution. Joaquin Panichelli is replaced by Kendry Paez (Strasbourg).
84' The defender did brilliantly to block the long-range effort from Marius Courcoul (Angers).
81' A substitution has been made. Haris Belkebla is replaced by Marius Courcoul (Angers).
81' One of the players from Strasbourg times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
81' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Strasbourg.
81' Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out. Strasbourg have been awarded a corner kick.
79' What was Ousmane Camara (Angers) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
77' Lucas Hogsberg will be replaced by Andrew Omobamidele (Strasbourg).
73' That's the end of the game for Valentin Barco, who is replaced by Rafael Luis (Strasbourg).
73' Here is a change. Felix Lemarechal is going off and Liam Rosenior gives the last tactical orders to Julio Enciso (Strasbourg).
73' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg) comes onto the pitch so that Martial Godo can be given a rest.
73' Substitution. Himad Abdelli makes his way off the pitch and Louis Mouton (Angers) comes on as his replacement.
73' Ousmane Camara (Angers) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Emmanuel Biumla.
70' 5 - 0 Goal! Martial Godo (Strasbourg) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 5:0.
67' Angers failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
66' 4 - 0 Goal! Martial Godo (Strasbourg) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 4:0.
65' Guillaume Paradis sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
63' Alexandre Dujeux decides to make a substitution. Lilian Raolisoa will be replaced by Florent Hanin (Angers).
63' It will be a substitution. Sidiki Cherif (Angers) is ready to enter the pitch as Justin-Noel Kalumba walks off.
63' The Strasbourg players halt their celebrations as referee Guillaume Paradis makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
61' 3 - 0 Abdoul Ouattara (Strasbourg) finds some space inside the box to meet a beautiful cross and with a precise low drive puts the ball into the bottom right corner.
59' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) gets a yellow card.
56' The resulting corner from Justin-Noel Kalumba (Angers) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
55' Justin-Noel Kalumba (Angers) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
54' The corner is swung in but Angers can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
51' 2 - 0 Goal! Felix Lemarechal plays a simple square pass into the feet of Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball into the bottom left corner. 2:0.
46' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) sends a cross into the box, but Herve Koffi comes off his line to gather the ball.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' Guillaume Paradis blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' A header by Justin-Noel Kalumba (Angers) from very close range goes towards the middle of the target, but doesn't get past Mike Penders, who makes a nice save.
44' Great save! Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the left side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Herve Koffi.

43' Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) shows good awareness deep inside the box as he latches on to a cross from the resulting free kick. He jumps high but his towering header lacks a little bit of accuracy and flies inches over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Angers will have a goal kick.
41' Half-chance! Abdoul Ouattara (Strasbourg) plays a pass into the box, but Herve Koffi reacts well to snuff out the attack.
36' 1 - 0 Goal! It's a catastrophic error from the opponent which has gifted a chance to Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg), who rolls the ball into the back of the net from close range. 1:0.
35' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
34' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) comes close as his long-range free kick goes a whisker over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Angers.
29' A cross from a corner kick by Angers is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

28' Lilian Raolisoa (Angers) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. Angers will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
28' Abdoul Ouattara (Strasbourg) finds his way to a rebound on the edge of the box, shoots to the bottom left corner, but the keeper dives and denies him.

27' A sweet pass finds Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom right corner. Herve Koffi is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
26' Guillaume Paradis shows a yellow card to Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) for his blatant foul.

26' Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and produces a low shot that sails towards the middle of a goal. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
25' A cross into the box from Martial Godo (Strasbourg) is cleared.
21' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) swings it in and Joaquin Panichelli gets on the end of it, but Herve Koffi shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.
17' Martial Godo (Strasbourg) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
15' The ratio of the ball possession is 78:22.
13' Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball goes out of play and Angers will have a goal kick.
11' Some great controlled play and passing from Strasbourg. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
6' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Haris Belkebla (Angers) was quite harsh and Guillaume Paradis didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
6' Justin-Noel Kalumba (Angers) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
6' Carlens Arcus (Angers) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The linesman points to the corner flag, Angers are going to take it.
3' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Angers will take the kick-off.
Guillaume Paradis got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
